svg.title: SAM vs ASAM · perturbation geometry
svg.desc: Illustrative w=(2,1), radius=0.8, T=diag(2,1); each perturbation maximises a linear objective over a circle (SAM) or ellipse (ASAM). The gradient direction sweeps through angles; points are exact at stated angles.
svg.text: Dashed: gradient direction Orange: maximising step
